title: n8n Telegram voice assistant books meetings in Google Calendar #shorts
description:
One n8n workflow turns a Telegram voice note into a booked meeting. The Telegram trigger catches the message, a voice note goes to Gemini to be transcribed, and an AI Agent with five tools does the rest: it reads your calendar, looks the person up in a contacts sheet, creates the Google Calendar event, sends the invite from Gmail and replies on Telegram with what it did. The Memory node keeps the chat, so "make it an hour" changes the same meeting.

The importable workflow and the node-by-node wiring notes are in the community: https://www.skool.com/nijoson-bosco-3533/about

You need n8n, a Telegram bot, a Google account (Calendar, Gmail, Sheets) and a Gemini key from Google AI Studio.

#n8n #automation #telegram #googlecalendar #gemini #aiagent
